# Session 6: Now Playing Screen — Implementation Plan

## What's Already Done

The core structure is fully in place from previous sessions. No new files need to be created.

- `NowPlayingScreen.kt` — full UI (portrait + landscape, album art, track info, format badge, seek slider, transport controls, VolumeSlider, favorite icon)
- `NowPlayingViewModel.kt` — all actions wired (play/pause, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, favorite)
- `PlayerController.kt` — MediaController connection, 500ms position polling, audio effects
- `VolumeSlider.kt` — 50-step logarithmic slider with haptic feedback and dB label
- `AudioFormatUtil.kt`, `VolumeUtil.kt` — utilities complete
- `MusicRepository.kt` — `setFavorite()` and `getTrackByIdFlow()` already present
- `AppModule.kt` — `DataStore<Preferences>` already provided by Hilt

## What's Missing (3 gaps)

### Gap 1: Volume / Shuffle / Repeat not persisted
`PlayerController.setVolume()`, `.setShuffleEnabled()`, `.setRepeatMode()` update the in-memory `_state` only. Restarting the app resets volume to 35, shuffle to off, repeat to off.

**Fix in [`PlayerController.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/service/PlayerController.kt)**

- Inject `DataStore<Preferences>` (already provided by Hilt)
- Add three DataStore keys:
  ```kotlin
  val VOLUME_LEVEL = intPreferencesKey("volume_level")
  val SHUFFLE_ENABLED = booleanPreferencesKey("shuffle_enabled")
  val REPEAT_MODE = intPreferencesKey("repeat_mode")
  ```
- In `init`: read all three keys from DataStore once and seed `_state` before the MediaController future resolves
- In each setter, call `dataStore.edit { ... }` to write the new value

### Gap 2: Current track lost on app-restart reconnect
When the app is killed but the service keeps running, `PlayerController.queue` is empty (in-memory). On reconnect, `onMediaItemTransition` cannot resolve the track from an empty queue, so `NowPlayingScreen` shows "No track selected" even though music is still playing.

**Fix in `onControllerReady()` in [`PlayerController.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/service/PlayerController.kt)**

After attaching the `Player.Listener`, check if a `currentMediaItem` already exists and load it from Room:
```kotlin
ctrl.currentMediaItem?.mediaId?.toLongOrNull()?.let { id ->
    scope.launch {
        val track = repo.getTrackById(id)
        val dur = ctrl.duration.takeIf { it != C.TIME_UNSET && it > 0 } ?: 0L
        _state.update { it.copy(currentTrack = track, durationMs = dur) }
    }
}
```

### Gap 3: Seek scrubber calls `seekTo` on every drag frame
`SeekSection` in [`NowPlayingScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/nowplaying/NowPlayingScreen.kt) currently calls `onSeek()` inside `onValueChange`, so ExoPlayer is seeked on every pixel of drag movement — causes position jitter and unnecessary work.

**Fix `SeekSection` in `NowPlayingScreen.kt`**

Add local drag state so the slider position is smooth during drag, and the actual seek only fires on release:
```kotlin
var isDragging by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
var dragProgress by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
val displayProgress = if (isDragging) dragProgress else
    if (state.durationMs > 0) state.progressMs.toFloat() / state.durationMs else 0f

Slider(
    value = displayProgress,
    onValueChange = { v ->
        isDragging = true
        dragProgress = v
    },
    onValueChangeFinished = {
        onSeek((dragProgress * state.durationMs).toLong())
        isDragging = false
    },
    ...
)
```

## Summary of File Changes

- **[`PlayerController.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/service/PlayerController.kt)** — inject DataStore, persist volume/shuffle/repeat, restore current track on reconnect
- **[`NowPlayingScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/nowplaying/NowPlayingScreen.kt)** — fix `SeekSection` to use local drag state + `onValueChangeFinished`

No new files, no new dependencies, no ViewModel changes needed.

1. While a track is playing, watch the scrubber — it should move smoothly (updates every 500ms)

1. Tap the **Repeat** icon once — it should show **Repeat One** (single track icon, primary color)
2. Let the track finish — it should loop the same track

5. Tap Repeat once more — icon goes gray (**Repeat Off**)
